name: Dangers of the Windfury
summary: Ruul Eagletalon asks you to test your readiness against the Windfury harpies in Mulgore. The hunt takes you to the southeastern cliffs, where their speed and claws put your skill to the test before you leave the tauren homeland.

sections.title: A Teacher's Assessment
sections.body: In Bloodhoof Village, Ruul Eagletalon watches travelers pass through Mulgore. He asks those coming of age or preparing for wider travels to prove their combat instincts. Beyond Mulgore's sheltered valleys, survival demands poise against cunning foes, and Ruul measures your mettle against the land's fiercest native predators.

sections.title: The Windfury Threat
sections.body: The Windfury harpies roost along Mulgore's southeastern mountain rim, away from the beaten trails. They threaten wandering wildlife and isolated travelers, diving swiftly and striking with razor-sharp claws as they hunt for fresh flesh. Defeating them and bringing back their talons proves you can overcome a settled threat and react quickly to aerial attackers.

aliases: who gives dangers of the windfury
faq.answer: Ruul Eagletalon is a veteran tauren warrior and teacher in Bloodhoof Village. He tests young adventurers before they travel into the more perilous reaches of Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where are the Windfury harpies found in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Windfury harpies roost along Mulgore's southeastern mountains, in crude nests high on the crags and foothill slopes. Their nests lie away from the main road through the valley.

faq.q: Why are the Windfury harpies considered natural enemies of the tauren?
faq.answer: The Windfury harpies are aggressive and territorial scavengers that attack those who come near their roosts. Their hunger for fresh meat and attacks on travelers and grazers make them a constant threat to the plains.

faq.q: What proof does Ruul Eagletalon demand from the hunt?
faq.answer: Ruul asks you to bring back eight Windfury Talons from slain harpies. The talons are their main natural weapons.

faq.q: Why must adventurers undergo this trial before leaving Mulgore?
aliases: why do dangers of the windfury
faq.answer: Ruul sees the Windfury harpies as a test of martial readiness. Their speed, ferocity, and claws challenge those preparing to face dangers beyond Mulgore's defensive bluffs.
Bloodhoof Village lies in central Mulgore near Stonebull Lake, south of the Great Gate and Thunder Bluff. Tauren travelers find culture, trade, and training there.

angles.text: As a young tauren, clearing Windfury nests helps defend the plains and marks a passage into acknowledged adulthood under the village elders' watch.
As a warrior, Ruul Eagletalon's challenge teaches you to parry swift diving strikes and face vicious aerial attackers with grounded discipline.
As an ally of the tauren, taking Ruul's trial shows your dedication to protecting the Horde's heartland and can earn the respect of Bloodhoof Village.
